title: Work and Time Efficiency
statement: Pipe A can fill a tank in 12 hours and Pipe B can fill it in 18 hours. If both pipes are opened simultaneously, how many hours will it take to fill the tank completely?
explanation: Combined rate = 1/12 + 1/18 = (3 + 2)/36 = 5/36 per hour. Total time = 36/5 = 7.2 hours.

title: Alternate Day Work by Two Workers
statement: A can finish a work in 15 days and B in 20 days. If they work on it together for 4 days, then what fraction of the work is left?
explanation: A's 1 day work = 1/15, B's 1 day work = 1/20. Together in 1 day = 1/15 + 1/20 = 7/60. In 4 days = 4 * 7/60 = 7/15. Work left = 1 - 7/15 = 8/15.

title: Relative Speed of Trains
statement: Two trains of length 150m and 120m travel on parallel tracks in opposite directions at 45 km/h and 63 km/h respectively. How many seconds will they take to completely pass each other?
explanation: Total distance = 150m + 120m = 270m. Relative speed = 45 + 63 = 108 km/h = 108 * (5/18) = 30 m/s. Time = 270 / 30 = 9 seconds.

title: Upstream and Downstream Boat Speed
statement: A boat travels 24 km upstream and 36 km downstream in 6 hours. It also travels 36 km upstream and 24 km downstream in 6.5 hours. What is the speed of the current?
explanation: Let upstream speed = u, downstream speed = v. 24/u + 36/v = 6 and 36/u + 24/v = 6.5. Solving gives u = 6 km/h, v = 12 km/h. Speed of current = (v - u)/2 = (12 - 6)/2 = 3... Wait, (12 - 6)/2 = 3 km/h? Let's verify: 24/8 + 36/12 = 3 + 3 = 6. 36/8 + 24/12 = 4.5 + 2 = 6.5. u=8, v=12. Current speed = (12 - 8)/2 = 2 km/h.

title: Successive Discounts Calculation
statement: A retailer offers two successive discounts of 20% and 10% on an article with a marked price of Rs. 500. What is the final selling price?
explanation: Effective price multiplier = (1 - 0.20) * (1 - 0.10) = 0.80 * 0.90 = 0.72. Final price = 500 * 0.72 = Rs. 360.

title: Profit and Loss with Faulty Weight
statement: A dishonest dealer professes to sell his goods at cost price but uses a weight of 900 grams for a 1 kg weight. Find his gain percentage.

title: Difference between CI and SI for 2 Years
statement: The difference between simple and compound interest compounded annually on a certain sum of money for 2 years at 10% per annum is Rs. 65. What is the sum?

title: Word Arrangement with Vowels Together
statement: In how many different ways can the letters of the word 'OPTICAL' be arranged so that the vowels always come together?
explanation: Word 'OPTICAL' has 7 letters: vowels O, I, A (3 vowels) and consonants P, T, C, L (4 consonants). Treat 3 vowels as 1 block -> 5 units (4 consonants + 1 block) arranged in 5! = 120 ways. The 3 vowels internally arrange in 3! = 6 ways. Total = 120 * 6 = 720 ways.

title: Two Dice Sum Probability
statement: In a simultaneous throw of a pair of dice, find the probability of getting a sum of 8.
explanation: Favorable outcomes for sum = 8: (2,6), (3,5), (4,4), (5,3), (6,2) -> 5 outcomes out of 36 total. Probability = 5/36.

title: Mixture and Alligation Ratio
statement: In a 60-liter mixture, the ratio of milk to water is 2:1. How much water must be added to make the ratio 1:2?
explanation: Milk = (2/3) * 60 = 40 L. Water = 20 L. For new ratio 1:2, Milk/Water = 40 / (20 + x) = 1/2 => 20 + x = 80 => x = 60 liters.
